## Rule

Live-equivalent table lookup on a 10x15 crop. Fourteen sampled cells form a unique template key; the matched template selects a 75-bit mask that is placed into rows 1..5 of the 10x15 crop, then original color-2 cells are overlaid and the result is returned as 30x30 one-hot.

### Structural decode candidate 2026-05-25

The visible pairs also admit a non-lookup rule: keep color 2 fixed; identify each connected color-5 component in the lower staging area; translate each component shape into the upper color-2 cavity layout; recolor translated cells to color 1; drop the original color-5 cells. The placement is an exact-cover problem over the top holes in rows 1 and 2: choose one stable ceiling-hung placement per source component so that all top holes are covered and selected placements do not overlap.

Numpy reference: `The_400_Tasks/Task_by_Task/task157/prototypes/task157_structural_reference.py` passes 265/265 visible pairs with `--verify-visible`. Current structural ONNX lowering: `The_400_Tasks/Task_by_Task/task157/prototypes/build_task157_structural_v1.py` emits `task157_structural_v1.onnx`; visible gate passes 265/265, and the former greedy ambiguity is fixed with a TopK exact-cover combination search. This remains a structural research candidate rather than a ship candidate because it is far more expensive than the live lookup graph.

## Algorithm sketch

`feature_bits = input[channel,row,col] > 0.5` at the 14 live `v5` positions, with channels inferred from nonzero entries in live `v6` (2 for top features, 5 for bottom features). Convert those bits to a 14-bit key and select the matching live template with exact `Equal(key, template_keys)`. The first two output-mask rows are just holes in input color-2 rows 1 and 2, so compute those dynamically; unpack only the remaining 45 live `v8` bits, gate on whether a match exists, build BOOL channels 0/1/2 for the 10x15 active area, and let final BOOL `Pad` add channels 3..9 plus spatial padding as false.

## Cost analysis

Current live cost is dominated by dense template projection: F16 `v8` is 265x75 (19,875 params) and F16 `v6` is 14x265 (3,710 params), plus full crop flattening for feature lookup. The best robust staged 2026-05-23 rewrite replaces `v6` with unique 14-bit keys, uses exact F32 `Equal` instead of squared-distance matching, computes the first 30 `v8` bits dynamically from color-2 holes, stores the remaining 45 bits as one uint64 word per template, unpacks with BitwiseAnd masks, samples the 14 features directly from input with `GatherND(batch_dims=1)`, and emits BOOL output by constructing only channels 0/1/2 before final Pad.
